Text: {delay 1}By holding down the CTRL-key and pressing keys 1 to 9, you can open and close various sub-menu windows.
{delay 1}Notice that the windows that are open are highlighted.
{delay 1}You can also minimize and maximize the windows by clicking on the window label.
{delay 1}What windows do you want me to tell you about?
{delay 1}<font color=#FF0000>[Debug] Dead end: the individual window topics have no replies yet.</font>
If you want to open your Inventory, press ' i ' on your keyboard
You can pick up any item from the inventory by left-clicking on the item. You can now move the item wherever you want it.
If you want to pick up an item from the ground, simply double-left-click on it, and it will be transferred to your inventory.
If you right-click on an item in the inventory, you will use that item (Note: not all items can be used, and some have specific requirements for you to be able to use them).

With your inventory open, right-click on your weapon to hold it in your hand. If you right-click an hold on an item, a short menu will appear, with various options for that item. Hold the mouse button down and move the cursor over the icons to see what their functions are.

If you hold down the ' SHIFT ' key and left-click on an item, you will get a detailed description of that item in a new window. Here you will find out what the item is for, and what the requirements for using the item is.
Using an item usually requires you to to be proficient in certain skills or be of a particular profession (such as trader or soldier).
There is more information available on the Inventory and Using Items. Do you want to know more?
{delay 1}I can provide you with information on a number of subjects. Just tell me what you would like to know more about.
{delay 1}If you prefer a more hands-on approach, I could also give you a couple of simple tasks to complete.
